label: Whatever presently gives another being presently actualizes it in every act it could lack
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred (accident-inclusive conservation): if g, distinct from x, presently actualizes x as to being (Holding.ActualizesNow g x esse) and x is in act in a respect r in which it could lack its act, then g presently actualizes x in r. It says that giving a thing being gives it being as it is, with its contingent acts (the iron's heat, the stone's motion), not bare existence. It is the bridge by which the esse instance of concurrent actualization reaches C* in the holding sense; without it the esse instance does not give C* (Control part 2: the iron's being is given, its heat is held by nothing). Not assessed here. Rival on record only as a lead: Molinist simultaneous concurrence (unread, navigation only) places the first cause's concurrence on the effect, not on the agent's power.
